market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely to remain volatile but net positive. Tech/AI momentum and falling oil support equities, but Xi-Trump summit and US-Iran talks create binary risk events. Gold/silver bid on uncertainty. Crypto momentum strong but $999M ETF inflow may face profit-taking. Diesel cost pressure weighs on transport. Watch Fed commentary for rate path clarity.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favor AI infrastructure, strategic metals, and energy transition. Diesel shortage through 2027 pressures traditional transport. India consumer and trade diversification offer EM alpha. China subdued oil imports signal demand softness. Geopolitical fragmentation (Greenland, Hormuz, Russia) drives resource nationalism. AI security vulnerabilities may create regulatory headwinds. Buffett's bear-market friend thesis suggests volatility will create entry points.
